tls_required.quote: By default, encryption in transit is enabled for newly created Amazon DocumentDB clusters. It can optionally be disabled when the cluster is created, or at a later time.
terraform_properties: aws_docdb_cluster_parameter_group.parameter value is enabled, tls1.2+, tls1.3+, or fips-140-3

fips_tls.quote: The cluster only accepts secure connections per the requirements of the Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) publication 140-3.

audit_logs.quote: The Amazon DocumentDB auditing feature is an opt-in feature.
terraform_properties: aws_docdb_cluster_parameter_group.parameter value is all, enabled, or ddl,dml_read,dml_write

audit_offload.quote: Ensure that both steps are completed, or audit logs will not be sent to CloudWatch Logs.

encryption_at_rest.quote: You encrypt data at rest in your Amazon DocumentDB cluster by specifying the storage encryption option when you create your cluster.

cmk_encryption.quote: Amazon DocumentDB uses the 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES-256) to encrypt your data using encryption keys stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
terraform_properties: aws_docdb_cluster.kms_key_id is a customer managed KMS key

supported_version.quote: Feature / Capability v3.6 v4.0 v5.0 v8.0 Support status EOL: Mar 2026 Active Active (LTS available) Active (GA Nov 2025)

network_restrictions.quote: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) makes it possible for you to launch AWS resources, such as Amazon DocumentDB instances, into a virtual private cloud (VPC).

managed_service.quote: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is a fast, reliable, and fully managed database service.
